# Acme UI

A fixture kit for the kit tools: calm surfaces, one accent.

## Consuming

Namespace `Acme`. Load `tokens.css`, `components/bundle.css`, then `components/bundle.js`; wrap the page in `Acme.Root`.

- Card — A raised block that groups a record's header and body on a page.
- Button — The main way to act on a page: submits a form or starts a flow.
